claims.statement: The ministry dates Amenhotep IV/Akhenaten’s rule to approximately 1352–1336 BCE.
The king promoted Aten worship and founded a new capital, Akhetaten, in Middle Egypt.

evidence.locator: Paragraphs on Amenhotep IV, the new capital, city layout and abandonment
evidence.note: Reign-sized context, not an exact date for every reform or the founding of the city. This ministry chronology differs slightly from the Met’s name-specific reign entries.
